spokenText:
Good morning! Here is your daily brief for today.

First, Azure updates. Microsoft has introduced Azure Container Apps Sandboxes in preview. The new sandbox lets you run untrusted AI agents in isolated virtual network environments with snapshot, egress and managed‑identity controls. In security news, OpenAI’s Defender’s Window outlines how artificial intelligence is reshaping cyber‑defense and offers concrete steps for hardening Azure workloads. At the same time, a major credential leak has exposed millions of records from corporate Azure tenants, affecting companies such as McDonald’s and Vodafone. Finally, Google Workspace now allows Gemini to access Gmail, Docs, Calendar and other services by default unless administrators turn the integration off.

Moving on to AI news. Startup Wispr announced a $280 million raise at a $2 billion valuation, signaling strong investor confidence beyond basic dictation use cases. Google’s Gemini team is partnering with Pixel to deliver AI‑powered visual features for live football‑club experiences. Microsoft is pulling the Excel Copilot side‑pane assistant, indicating a redesign of the user interface. The company also attributed a delayed Exchange update to a backlog of AI‑generated bugs. OpenAI has joined the PORTS‑Pike project, expanding AI community investment and supporting thousands of jobs in Ohio. In the broader AI tooling space, Dynatrace acquired Arize for $915 million to boost AI observability, and GitHub Copilot’s latest update adds a model catalog and offline support for developers.

Now for the markets. Bears are piling into Nasdaq futures as short positions hit record levels, reflecting bearish sentiment in tech. Meanwhile, stock indexes are holding steady ahead of the Federal Reserve minutes and upcoming retail earnings, providing modest support. Pershing Square’s latest 13F filing shows new stakes in Netflix, Visa, Mastercard and S&P Global, highlighting a bullish tech positioning. C3 is announcing a 1‑for‑40 reverse split as Nasdaq listing pressure builds, and RVT stock has climbed to a 52‑week high of $19.05.

Bottom line: AI‑driven tooling is reshaping both cloud operations and security, while a spate of Azure‑related breaches underscores the need for tighter identity and data controls. That is your update. Have a great day!
